Expressive warm amber eye, gentle curious face, restrained lovely 2D ink and painted cel shading, never a photoreal or 3D creature, no exact existing film character. The WHOLE unbroken dragon must be shown, including head, every body curve and tail, no clipped body. Landscape 1536x1024 composition, clear transparent margins. Precise composition: head is prominently in the LOWER LEFT, occupies approximately x=80..510, y=700..970, faces left and slightly toward the viewer. From the back of the head, the slim neck flows right across the lower third through about (800,780), then curves upward along the RIGHT half as a long elegant S, ending in a much slimmer tail in the UPPER RIGHT quadrant. No second head, no disconnected segments, no giant wings, no ring-shaped body. Head and forward neck are closer and have crisp readable linework; the rear body and tail become progressively smaller, softer, lower contrast and bluer as if receding through deep water. Preserve visible continuity through this gradual transition. Subtle underwater caustic glints on the forehead and front neck, no self-illumination and no magic aura. No air bubbles baked into this plate, no water surface, no fog backdrop, no architecture, no props, no floor shadow, no text. Truly transparent background everywhere outside the character. This plate will be divided into far and near parts for one dragon entering a flooded teahouse through its opening.
